Maps and cartography

Automatic, explained maps, thematic maps, projections, graticules, basemaps and GeoSpaX-style map furniture.

3D terrain maps

Spatial analysis

Interpolation and kriging, spatial autocorrelation and hotspots, distances, computed in C++ on several cores.

geo_interpolate()
Interpolate point measurements onto a grid
geo_hotspot() geo_lisa()
Local spatial statistics: hotspots and LISA clusters
geo_dbscan()
Point clusters with DBSCAN
geo_landscape()
Landscape fragmentation metrics
geo_moran()
Moran's I for spatial autocorrelation of diversity
geo_distance()
Pairwise geographic or elevational distances
geo_decay()
Distance decay with geographic, elevational or environmental distance
geo_mem()
Distance-based Moran's eigenvector maps (dbMEM)

Terrain and hydrology

D8 flow direction, flow accumulation, watersheds, the topographic wetness index and terrain derivatives.

geo_flow_direction() geo_flow_accumulation() geo_watershed() geo_twi()
Terrain hydrology: flow direction, accumulation, watersheds and TWI
geo_elevation()
Download or read elevation (SRTM-style DEM)

Plot diversity surfaces and their uncertainty

Clean occurrence coordinates

Import GBIF-style occurrence records

Export a site-by-feature matrix for conservation planning
